recipe.title: Beef pot roast
recipe.notes: We make this with tinned tomatoes instead of stock so that we can puree a bit for Eleanor (age 6 months).
recipe.prep: Preheat the slow cooker on low.

i.n: kumara, large (about 400 g), peeled and cut into 3 cm pieces
carrots, peeled and cut into thick rings

method.s: Put vegetables into slow cooker. Add piece of topside, fat side up.
Mix together beef stock, red wine (if using) and tomato paste. Pour over.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours, until meat is tender.
Mix cornflour into a little cold water to a smooth paste. Whisk into sauce, then season to taste.
